episodes.title: When God Doesn't Heal: Losing My Wife to Cancer
episodes.summary: This week, we sit down with Caleb to hear the story of losing his wife, Morgan, to cancer after years of praying for healing. We talk about unanswered prayers, walking through grief, and learning to trust God's goodness when life doesn't turn out the way we hoped.

episodes.title: Living with Stage 4 Cancer, Praying for a Miracle
episodes.summary: This week, we talk with Jenn Cohorst about living with stage 4 lung cancer and praying for healing. We discuss raising daughters through an uncertain future and trusting God when the miracle you want isn’t guaranteed.

episodes.title: Economics of Outrage
episodes.summary: This week, we explore how outrage became profitable, why social media rewards anger, and how Christians contribute to the cycle. We discuss the difference between righteous anger and manufactured controversy, and how to engage with culture without taking the bait.

episodes.title: Why Is It So Hard to Be Single in the Church?
episodes.summary: This week, Alex sits down with author and theologian Wesley Hill to talk about celibacy, spiritual friendship, and why the church often struggles to make room for single Christians.

episodes.title: When Scripture Changes Your Mind: Preston Sprinkle
episodes.summary: This week, Alex sits down with theologian and author Preston Sprinkle to discuss sexuality, gender, and what he's learned from listening to LGBTQ people.

episodes.title: Are We Misrepresenting Jesus in the Immigration Crisis?
episodes.summary: This week, we sit down with Dr. Jonathan Schaeffer, president of the Christian and Missionary Alliance, and his wife, Mary, to discuss immigration.

episodes.title: The CDC Says You Need More Rest
episodes.summary: This week, we look at why young adults are reporting more exhaustion than any other age group.

episodes.title: Living With Cystic Fibrosis: Justin’s Story of Suffering, Hope & Faith
episodes.summary: This week, Eric sat down with Justin to talk about growing up with cystic fibrosis.

episodes.title: No Colon, Still Rollin’
episodes.summary: This week, Jess sits down with Joe to talk about childhood wounds and major health challenges.

episodes.title: When Your Body Fails: Faith, Fear & a Kidney Transplant
episodes.summary: This week, we sit down with Chad to talk about kidney failure, dialysis, and the long wait for a transplant.

episodes.title: Calvinism vs Arminianism
episodes.summary: This week, we sit down with Ken Dick and Mark Ashton to unpack Calvinism and Arminianism.

episodes.title: Healthy Sex in Marriage
episodes.summary: This week, we sit down with Eric and Rachel Dufour for an honest conversation about sex and intimacy in Christian marriage.

episodes.title: The Gang Is Back Together
episodes.summary: This week, we catch up on what’s been on our minds this summer.

episodes.title: Living and Following Jesus in the Middle East
episodes.summary: This week, we go beyond the headlines with “Daniel”.

episodes.title: What Should Christians Think About the World's First Trillionaire?
episodes.summary: This week, Alex is joined by Scott Kubie, President of Orchard Alliance.
